scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back"
scripts.build: npm run --prefix front build && rm -rf dist && cp -r front/dist dist
scripts.build:all: npm run --prefix front build && npm run --prefix back build
scripts.test: npm run --prefix front test && npm run --prefix back test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run --prefix front test:coverage && npm run --prefix back test:coverage
